# ImmoScanner

> Scan real estate portals in Belgium, Switzerland, France and Germany for a town, a postal code or a region: de-duplicated listings, price statistics, gross rental yields, a BRRRR ranking of fixer-uppers, an archive of every scan and a web explorer. Python 3.10+, uv, cyclopts CLI (`immoscanner scan | yield | brrrr | serve`).

Portals: immoweb.be and immovlan.be (Belgium), comparis.ch (Switzerland), bienici.com (France), kleinanzeigen.de and immowelt.de (Germany) are verified on captured pages; leboncoin.fr, seloger.com, pap.fr and immobilienscout24.de answer with anti-bot walls, which ImmoScanner reports as `BotWallError` and never bypasses.

## Code

- [ImmoScanner/Console.py](https://github.com/UyttenhoveSimon/ImmoScanner/blob/master/ImmoScanner/Console.py): the command line
- [ImmoScanner/ImmoScanner.py](https://github.com/UyttenhoveSimon/ImmoScanner/blob/master/ImmoScanner/ImmoScanner.py): one scan, end to end
- [ImmoScanner/Workers/](https://github.com/UyttenhoveSimon/ImmoScanner/tree/master/ImmoScanner/Workers): one reader per portal
- [ImmoScanner/Intellectuals/](https://github.com/UyttenhoveSimon/ImmoScanner/tree/master/ImmoScanner/Intellectuals): statistics, condition reading, BRRRR ranking
